rule: within each frozen J>=0.50 cluster, the member with the highest MEAN Jaccard to the other members (membership medoid); tie-break lowest sealed j; singleton = itself
selection_is_x_only: Jaccard is membership only and sealed j is membership only. No outcome enters the choice — picking by max Z or max theta would make the loudest result the face of each family and every downstream number would inherit that selection.
full_matrix_note: single linkage lets two members of one cluster have low pairwise Jaccard, so the medoid uses the FULL within-cluster matrix, not the J>=0.10 pair file
